title: Parties UI: list, detail, new/edit
objective: Parties workspace per PRD 12.9: filterable list with lead counts, detail page with leads card and pre-filled + New Lead, full-page new/edit form with duplicate warning and optional region (spec FR-26..FR-28).
scope: List: columns per FR-26, filters, type-ahead search, sort, 25/page, export button (wired fully in T-039), empty state

Detail: header, summary panel, Leads card (columns from Leads list minus Party; activates fully once T-027 exists — placeholder table until then acceptable only if T-027 already merged; ordering ensures it is not), + New Lead pre-filled and locked
New/Edit form with non-blocking duplicate-name warning banner
implementation_details: features/parties/PartiesListPage.tsx: DataTable with server-driven sort/filter/page via partiesApi; columns Party name link, type, segment, industry, region, strategic flag icon, open leads, total leads, last activity

PartyDetailPage.tsx: header (name, type chip, strategic flag, Edit party permission-gated); summary grid; LeadsCard reusing the shared leads table component (from T-027 — declare soft dependency; render with the same column config minus Party); + New Lead navigates to /leads/new?partyId={id} (T-026 consumes and locks the party section)

PartyFormPage.tsx: two-column grid — name (required), party type (required), industry, segment, strategic toggle, contact name/email/phone (format validation), region (optional per Q-9); duplicate-name warning rendered as dismissible warning banner listing matches with links (non-blocking, from the warnings payload); unsaved-changes prompt; success toast + navigate to detail

e2e: parties.spec.ts: create party without region succeeds; create near-duplicate name shows warning banner but allows save; list filters by type and searches as-you-type; detail shows summary and (once leads exist) the leads card; + New Lead from detail opens intake with party locked; edit persists changes
